limits: Same server retains prior four-long-request KV/cache/graph history; distinct nonces and zero cache counters establish cold requests, not a fresh process.
Eight submissions queue behind four active HP slots; this does not establish eight active sessions.
Client results are in input order, but API records lack server IDs. Raw server IDs are validated within each case without a client-to-ID join.
Per-client decode TPS uses (1024 - 1) / (client wall - TTFT); whole aggregate TPS includes prompt processing and queued waiting.
SSE gap measurements describe client-observed content chunks, which may contain multiple model tokens; they are not model inter-token latency.
Memory guard observations are sampled and do not establish unsampled behavior.
Sampled outputs can follow different RNG and speculative trajectories; this profile does not establish controlled cross-mode speedup or general quality.
